name: AWI Television Championship
epitaph: Gary White's belt through the held record's two-show window, successfully defended at Explosion against a challenger distracted by a mysterious ringside stranger.

name: AWI World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Won by Megaton at the AWI Union supercard, a title change this collection knows only by recap, never by its own primary document.

name: AWI North American Championship
epitaph: Changed hands at the AWI Union supercard when War Machine beat the previous UWA-lineage North American champion, Jack Fury -- recapped in exact-dated detail by Mission Control's own courtroom segment.

name: AWI World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: D.A. Bookthrower's belt as of the held record's Mission Control -- the “Legal Eagle” never himself appears on screen to defend it in either held document.
notes: Confirms, by primary-source Usenet content, the third of the three AWI-branded titleholders (a World, a World Tag Team and a Television champion) this wing's own registry row already cited from cwfpro's unification ledger.
